verdict.rationale: Lambda offers explicit Managed Slurm (auto-scheduling, health-managed daemons, standard Slurm tooling, quick start to multi-node jobs) and Managed Kubernetes (MK8s with GPU/InfiniBand support, preconfigured for workload deployment) as first-party managed services on top of 1-Click Clusters, directly satisfying the need to avoid building a custom scheduler on raw nodes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the managed Slurm/K8s experience itself (only community evidence found relates to billing and an unofficial CLI, not scheduler usage).
